items.source: Spring's CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor supports the PostConstruct and PreDestroy annotations out of the box, as init annotation and destroy annotation, respectively. Furthermore, it also supports the Resource annotation for annotation-driven injection of named beans.
items.translation: Spring 的CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor原生支持PostConstruct和PreDestroy注解，分别作为初始化注解和销毁注解。此外，它还支持Resource注解，用于基于注解的命名 Bean 注入。

items.source: The actual annotation types that this post-processor checks for can be configured through the "initAnnotationType" and "destroyAnnotationType" properties. Any custom annotation can be used, since there are no required annotation attributes.
items.translation: 此后置处理器实际检查的注解类型可以通过 `"initAnnotationType"` 和 `"destroyAnnotationType"` 属性进行配置。由于没有必需的注解属性，因此可以使用任何自定义注解。

items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他BeanPostProcessor回调不同。

items.source: Any custom annotation can be used, since there are no required annotation attributes. There is no default, although a typical choice is the PostConstruct annotation.
items.translation: 任何自定义注解均可使用，因为不存在必需的注解属性。虽然不存在默认值，但典型的选择是 `PostConstruct` 注解。

items.source: Any custom annotation can be used, since there are no required annotation attributes. There is no default, although a typical choice is the PreDestroy annotation.
items.translation: 任何自定义注解均可使用，因为不存在必需的注解属性。虽然不存在默认值，但典型的选择是 `PreDestroy` 注解。

items.source: The default implementation returns the given bean as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

items.source:
Init and destroy annotations may be applied to methods of any visibility:
public, package-protected, protected, or private. Multiple such methods
may be annotated, but it is recommended to only annotate one single
init method and destroy method, respectively.
items.translation: 初始化注解和销毁注解可以应用于任何可见性的方法：public、包保护、protected 或 private。可以对多个此类方法进行注解，但建议分别只注解一个 init 方法和一个 destroy 方法。

methods to call after configuration of a bean.
items.translation: 添加一个 `init` 注解以进行检查，指示在配置完 Bean 后需要调用的初始化方法。

items.translation: 要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例；如果为null，则不会调用后续的 BeanPostProcessor。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Stephane Nicoll, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Jürgen Höller, Stéphane Nicoll, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen

items.source: The default implementation returns true. If a pre-5 implementation of DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor does not provide a concrete implementation of this method, Spring silently assumes true as well.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。如果 5 版本之前的实现未提供此方法的具象实现，Spring 也会静默地假设其为true。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source: If the given instance isn't relevant to the processor, it should return a null contribution.
items.translation: 如果给定的实例与处理器不相关，则应返回一个 `null` 贡献。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

items.source: Like DisposableBean's destroy and a custom destroy method, this callback will only apply to beans which the container fully manages the lifecycle for. This is usually the case for singletons and scoped beans.
items.translation: 与 `DisposableBean` 的 `destroy` 方法和自定义销毁方法类似，此回调仅适用于容器完全管理生命周期的 Bean。通常，单例和作用域 Bean 都属于这种情况。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.source:
Processors are free to use any techniques they like to analyze the given
instance. Most typically use reflection to find fields or methods to use
in the contribution. Contributions typically generate source code or
resource files that can be used when the AOT optimized application runs.
items.translation: 处理器可以自由使用任何技术来分析给定的实例。大多数情况下，它们使用反射来查找用于贡献的字段或方法。贡献通常会生成源代码或资源文件，这些文件可在 AOT 优化后的应用程序运行时使用。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance after any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，且是在任何 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之后。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance before any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).

items.source: Process the given RegisteredBean instance ahead-of-time and return a contribution or null.
items.translation: 提前处理给定的RegisteredBean实例并返回贡献或null。
